changelog: - **`command-palette.spec.ts` no longer sends its shortcut key before anything listens for it** (#2480). The spec pressed Ctrl+K / `?` once, right after `waitForURL` on the landing page, then waited 15s for a dialog. `waitForURL` resolves on the document `load` event. The palette's shortcuts are a `document` keydown listener added in a `useEffect`, so they exist only after hydration. On a busy e2e-full shard the key arrived before hydration, reached no listener and was lost, and the dialog could never open. That produced the 16.1–16.2s failures in 2 of 3 scheduled runs of one unchanged commit, with the failing assertion changing from run to run. `CommandPalette` now sets `<html data-shortcuts="ready">` in the same effect that attaches the listener and removes it in that effect's cleanup. The spec waits for that attribute before its first key press. The Escape test also had a false pass: its check that Ctrl+K typed into the header search opens nothing could pass just because nothing was listening yet. No timeout was raised and nothing was skipped.
